grave_robber.plan: Black control: kills and edicts, then a draining finish
grave_robber.taunt: That's a fine deck. Shame you'll be buried with it.

ember_bandit.home: The east road, by the bridge
ember_bandit.plan: Red aggression: cheap attackers and burn to the face
ember_bandit.taunt: Toll's your purse. Or your life. Pick fast, we're fast.

thornback.home: The moor's thickets and bog edge
thornback.plan: Green stomp: big creatures early, pumped to hit harder
thornback.taunt: The bracken stirs. Something heavy shoulders through.

drowned_cultist.plan: Blue fliers with flash, counterspells and bounce
drowned_cultist.taunt: The tide says no. The tide always says no.

zealot.plan: White heroics: one creature, stacked with auras and boons
zealot.taunt: Kneel, scribe. The light only blesses the kneeling.

wild_elf.plan: Green-blue elves: early ramp into a wide, pumped board
wild_elf.taunt: One of us is a scout. The rest are behind you.

hive_spawn.plan: Slivers: each one makes every other one stronger
hive_spawn.taunt: The hive hums. Every voice the same voice.

clockwork_golem.plan: Red-white artifacts: cheap fliers, metalwork, removal
clockwork_golem.taunt: CHALLENGER DETECTED. GEARS ENGAGED. PLEASE HOLD.

grave_priest.home: The deepest crypt of the Warrens
grave_priest.plan: White-black: lifegain feeds a plague that sweeps the board
grave_priest.taunt: Hush now. The dead are waiting for one more voice.
intro: Ah. A scribe. Orrin's, by the ink on your fingers. He came this way too, before the Hush took him.
Look at them. My congregation. No fear, no hunger, no quarrels. The Hush is peace.
Your Accord is a candle in a gale. I put out one hall. Let me show you how I'll put out the rest.
defeated: No... the Echoes are going quiet. They're remembering. Why are they remembering?
He said the Hush would keep us. Your master's map, take it. It never led him home either.

plague_rat.plan: Red-black: burn and madness, and sacrifice for value
plague_rat.taunt: Squeak of claws in the dark. Many claws. Coming closer.
